description: The 2003 run moves through Easter crafts, fitness, vending machinery, slot cars, an aquarium, food preserving, homemade flight and winter projects before ending with illness, fax technology and an enormous strawberry harvest.

s09e01.description: An Easter mishap ruins the decorated eggs, so Pat and Mat decide to create a replacement worthy of the holiday, scaling a familiar craft into a distinctly overengineered project.

s09e02.description: After a heavy meal, Pat and Mat decide they need to slim down. Measuring, exercise equipment and dietary ambition soon become another field for homemade solutions and dubious efficiency.

s09e03.description: A large drinks vending machine arrives at the house, and Pat and Mat have to get it inside, connect it and make sense of its mechanism before they can enjoy anything it is meant to dispense.

s09e04.description: Pat and Mat assemble a slot-car set and keep expanding the track around real obstacles in the room, turning a toy racing circuit into a sprawling piece of household infrastructure.

s09e05.description: Mat brings home a fish, and the pair set about making it a proper aquarium from what they can find, converting an ordinary container into a miniature aquatic home.

s09e06.description: Pat and Mat tackle a preserving job with more produce than they want to prepare by hand, so kitchen appliances and improvised processing methods are recruited to speed up the work.

s09e07.description: Inspired by hang gliding, Pat and Mat decide to build their own glider from a sketch, ordinary materials and the absolute confidence that flight can be engineered at home.

s09e08.description: After the Christmas bread is spoiled, Pat and Mat decide to bake a replacement themselves, turning a seasonal treat into a full-scale exercise in mixing, shaping and improvised baking.

s09e09.description: Mat is ill and Pat takes over as nurse, preparing hot tea and checking his temperature with equipment that has already been used for other purposes, making the diagnosis considerably more dramatic than necessary.

s09e10.description: Mat brings home a pair of fax machines and teaches Pat how to use them. Their experiments with sending pictures soon reveal unintended possibilities for a device neither man intends to use conventionally.

s09e11.description: A huge strawberry harvest needs cleaning and preserving, so Pat and Mat recruit household appliances to accelerate the work and discover how quickly one runaway berry can complicate an automated system.
